svg.aria-label: The record, in date order. Sep 2024: B.E. Information Science and Engineering. RV College of Engineering, Bengaluru. CGPA 9.6. Graduating August 2028. Dec 2024: Selected into Coding Club RVCE. Junior Core Team in 2025. Oct 2025: Rewind & Recode 2025. 1st in Karnataka with LearnMate AI, then 3rd in the national finals with EduSynth. D3 Tech Fest, IIIT Bhubaneswar. Apr 2026: VISISONICS AI’26. 2nd place with INDRA in a 20-hour build judged by Hitachi India R&D engineers. 2026: IEEE YESIST12. 6th place in the India preliminary round with NyayaSetu. 2026: NQComp-2026. Presented the AllerSafe paper, IEEE and Scopus indexed. Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru. Aug 2026: 1st India Computer Vision Hackathon. 1st in track and 5th overall. RV College of Engineering. 2026–27: Vice President, Coding Club RVCE. The club’s tenth year.
